game_subtitle: A story of a fallen ship and a valley that remembers
hint_talk: Point at the Warden and pull the trigger to talk. Desktop: click it, or press E.
hint_move: Left stick: walk. Right stick: turn. Push the right stick down to teleport. Desktop: WASD to walk, drag the mouse to look around.
hint_grab: Point at a part and hold the trigger to grab it. Desktop: press E to pick up and E to drop.
hint_deliver: Carry the part to Tobbin's basket and let go above it.
hint_lantern: The Pulse Lantern hangs from your left hand. Pull the left trigger to pulse. Desktop: press F.
hint_menu: Press the menu button on the left controller for your journal and settings. Desktop: Tab or Esc.
hint_act1_done: Act 1 complete. The mist has thinned: Glimmerwood (west), Rustdune Canyon (east) and the Skyreach Isles (north, by the cargo lift) are open to explore.
toast_mist: The mist is too thick to go further.
